properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/an_import_says_what_it_removed_and_merges_only_when_asked.rs, the CLASS over three node types: for every node a document names that the design already held, the reply's properties_removed / properties_changed equal what a read-back shows, materialized never names a key the node held, removed_from names a node and what it lost; with merge nothing the document omits is lost; a round trip of the design's own export reports nothing; a node missing a required property is refused and nothing is written.
properties.findings: 4 passed on feat/p7-a-hub-on-one-machine-small; the two behavioural tests failed on main d388b60ee (properties_removed absent: reply counted {} against 10 removed values; `merge` refused as an unknown field). The round-trip and refusal tests pass on main too: they pin what must not change.
properties.name: An import says what it removed and merges only when asked: four MCP tests
